synopsis: Chapter 11 and the glossary identify RoadRunner with Automated Driving Toolbox as tools for reconstructing and replaying recorded scenarios, categorized under data replay and hardware-in-the-loop [f8366, f16039]. Reconstruction uses camera, lidar, GPS and IMU logs, but reconstruction and replay quality is bounded by tracking and map reconstruction accuracy [f8656, f8657]. The tools are commercial, listed as adaptable for off-road use, and expose a MATLAB interface; pricing requires a quote, and the latest release found was R2026b [f9250, f9251, f9252, f9253, f9254]. Automated Driving Toolbox also appears in the middle-cost model-based engineering stack alongside MATLAB/Simulink R2026b, the Offroad Autonomy Library, RoadRunner, RoadRunner Scenario, Unreal, and Radar and sensor toolboxes [f9285].

relations.note: Both identify the paired tools for scenario reconstruction and replay.
Specifies sensor logs used to reconstruct recorded scenarios.
Qualifies reconstruction and replay with tracking and map accuracy limits.
Adds input modalities and saved-scenario replay to the category description.
Identifies accuracy limits on the described reconstruction and replay method.
Commercial pricing is quote-based rather than a stated price.
MATLAB interface supports inclusion in the MATLAB/Simulink engineering stack.
Latest replay release matches the stack's R2026b version designation.
